content_sections.heading: ESIC Andheri Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Andheri East intends to fill 76 posts across Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Senior Resident and Tutor cadres. As per the notification, these vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease based on actual teaching and patient-care requirements.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Andheri Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility. The notification states that the educational and experience criteria for all advertised posts are as per the latest NMC (National Medical Commission) Gazette notification. The document lists this NMC Gazette notification date as 30.06.2025 in the general notes section and as 30.06.2026 in the Educational Qualification section — both dates appear in the official PDF, and candidates are advised to verify the exact date directly with ESIC or the official notification before applying. In summary, candidates should hold the MBBS/MD/MS/DNB/PG Diploma qualification (as applicable to the post applied for) with updated NMC/State Medical Council registration, meeting the specific teaching/experience norms prescribed under the applicable NMC Gazette notification. All candidates must have updated Medical Registration (NMC/State Medical Council) along with post-MBBS/MD/MS qualification. If updated registration is not available, candidates must submit a copy of the "applied for" document at the time of interview.

content_sections.text: Pay is fixed as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC), with Basic Pay plus other allowances (DA, NPA, TA, HRA, etc.) as applicable. content_sections.heading: ESIC Andheri Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on the candidate's acquired academic credentials and performance in the interview before the Selection Board. The result will be displayed in the Recruitment section of www.esic.gov.in. The Offer of Appointment will be sent through e-mail only. Selected candidates must join as per the instructions in the offer of appointment; if a selected candidate does not join within the prescribed time, the offer will be issued to the waitlisted candidate. The engagement is for 1 (one) year, extendable up to 3 (three) years, subject to satisfactory performance, or till attainment of 68 years of age, whichever is earlier. The contract may be terminated from either side with one month's prior notice; in case of spot resignation, one month's salary must be deposited to the ESI account. No service benefits such as PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance, Medical Benefits, Seniority, or Promotion will be admissible. Absence from work beyond 7 days without permission will be treated as voluntary abandonment and result in automatic termination. Faculty must mark attendance manually as well as on the Aadhaar Enabled Biometric Attendance System (AEBAS) daily. No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining as teaching faculty/Senior Resident.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC Andheri Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: There is no online application process for this recruitment. ESIC Andheri Recruitment 2026 follows a walk-in (offline) interview mode. Candidates must carry the original Application Form along with supporting documents and the original Demand Draft (as interview fee, if applicable) to the interview venue. Reporting Time: 09:30 AM to 11:30 AM Venue: Dean Office, 5th Floor, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, MIDC, Opposite MIDC Police Station, Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra - 400093 Interview Dates: 01, 02 and 03 September 2026, as per the department and post applied for (see the vacancy table above) The application must be submitted separately for each post, in the prescribed format only. Applications in any other format, or incomplete applications, will be summarily rejected. Candidates should ascertain their eligibility themselves and report for the interview on the scheduled date and time. The final result, including the waiting list, will be published only on the official website (www.esic.gov.in/recruitments). Mere submission of an application does not confer any right to be interviewed unless the candidate reports on the scheduled date and time with the required documents. Opportunity for interview is provisional, subject to detailed scrutiny of eligibility criteria. The Dean, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Andheri East, Mumbai, reserves the right to cancel or postpone the recruitment process at any stage. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview or for submission of documents. Candidates working in Government/Autonomous/Statutory institutions should preferably carry an NOC from their employer at the time of interview, or a copy of the "applied for NOC."

faq.question: Q1. What is ESIC Andheri Medical College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Andheri East, Mumbai (Advertisement No. 12/2026) to fill Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Senior Resident and Tutor posts on a contract basis through a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ESIC Andheri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 76 vacancies are available: 16 Professor, 20 Associate Professor, 14 Assistant Professor, 18 Senior Resident, and 8 Tutor posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ESIC Andheri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application or last date; candidates must attend the walk-in interview in person on 01, 02 or 03 September 2026, depending on their department and post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for ESIC Andheri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must meet the educational and experience criteria as per the latest NMC Gazette notification applicable to the post, along with updated NMC/State Medical Council registration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ESIC Andheri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit as on 31.08.2026 is not exceeding 68 years for Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor and Tutor posts, and not exceeding 45 years for Senior Resident, as on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ESIC Andheri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: UR/OBC candidates must pay Rs. 500/- through a Demand Draft in favour of "ESI Fund Account No.1," payable at Mumbai. SC/ST, ESIC regular employees, female candidates, defence ex-servicemen, and PH candidates are exempted from the fee.
